name: Overlay
description: Floating content surface unifying tooltip, popover and hover card.

content.description: Content of the floating surface; empty content renders the trigger alone. Tooltip content must stay noninteractive.

children.description: One trigger element forwarding props/ref, or text rendered as a Button.

open.description: Controlled visibility; updates from the parent never call onOpenChange.

defaultOpen.description: Visibility on mount when `open` is not set; read once.

side.description: Preferred side; may flip when the opposite side has more room.

align.description: Logical alignment on the cross axis, following dir or the trigger's direction.

sideOffset.description: Gap in pixels between the trigger and the content membrane; negative values overlap them. Default 2.

dir.description: Content direction; omitted inherits the trigger's, auto follows the content.

openDelay.description: Milliseconds from hover or focus to showing the surface, 0–2147483647; default 200.

closeDelay.description: Milliseconds from hover and focus leaving to hiding the surface, 0–2147483647; default 0.

openOn.description: Opens on hover and keyboard focus of the trigger, or toggles on its click.

interactive.description: Hover content holds controls: dialog semantics, and focus it took returns to the trigger.

notes: Only click and interactive hover content dismiss on an outside interaction. Click content receives focus on opening. Informational hover content retains trigger focus.
Hover informational content uses role="tooltip". Click content and interactive hover content use role="dialog".
Trigger props and ref belong to the actual trigger element; primitive content uses Text typography.
sideOffset measures the gap before the shared Membrane; the public content ref, attributes, style and class belong to one surface.

whenToUse: Compatibility for existing hover cards; prefer Tooltip or Popover in new code.
